en-US.description: An unofficial Windows tray app that shows your Claude usage limits at a glance.
en-US.longDescription:
Claude Usage Tray shows the usage limits of your Claude subscription in the Windows system tray: a live
percentage rendered into the tray icon, and a dark flyout with every usage window, reset countdowns, plan tier,
burn rate, history charts and token and cost analytics derived from local Claude Code session logs.

It is an unofficial community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Anthropic. It
reads the OAuth token Claude Code already stores on this machine so it can call the same usage endpoint Claude
Code itself uses, and it never writes to the Claude Code configuration. No telemetry. It asks GitHub once a week
whether a newer release exists, which sends nothing about you and can be turned off in its settings.

Requires Claude Code to be installed and signed in at least once for the usage percentages. The local token and
cost analytics work offline.
en-US.name: Claude Usage Tray
